reseq-mk1.title: What is RESE.Q MK1
reseq-mk1.description: It is the team’s first prototype to achieve the goal of creating an innovative robot for SAR operations. Our idea is to have a modular crawler robot with two possible configurations: robotic arm and crawler robot. So that he can easily navigate dangerous situations, to explore the environment without risking the lives of rescuers.

features.title: features
features.description:
Modular structure:
Allows you to adapt the robot to different scenarios, with specialized modules
Configuration snake-like:
Allows more agility in movement
strong>Robotic arm configuration:
For vertical lifting of part of the robot
Remote control:
Via a remote control and a camera on the robot, with future possibilities of autonomous and semi-autonomous driving.

objectives.title: Goals
objectives.description: The purpose of Rese. Q Mk1 is to provide support to rescuers in emergency situations. Its current capabilities are:

slides.2: Exploration and mapping of unsafe areas
slides.3: Transport of food, medicine and other first aid items via a dedicated add-on module
slides.4: Securing dangerous areas, with the help of a gripper on the front module to act on any sources of risk
